In shikigami battles, you lose{0000}when all your shikigami hit 0 HP.{0010}You won't die, but battles may{0000}come one after another, my boy.{0010}Always keep an eye on your HP.{0010}Recovery points can restore HP,{0000}but don't let your guard down.{0010}Gather as many shikigami as you can{0000}and prepare for long battles, eh?{0010}

A Tojinshi must give orders{0000}to their shikigami.{0010}We give orders through patterns{0000}of lines called "seals," my boy.{0010}Choose "Attack" in the "Drive"{0000}to open the seal input screen.{0010}Enter the seal with the + Pad: right{0000}strokes turn red, wrong ones blue.{0010}Keep the reds coming and{0000}the "seal" glows gold.{0010}That's the proof the "seal" is done.{0010}A finished "seal" reaches your{0000}shikigami as a special move.{0010}Mind this well: you can't make{0000}"seals" whenever you please.{0010}In battle, a seal uses up the bar{0000}under your HP, the Shiki Points,{0010}to complete the "seal."{0010}And so, use small moves often,{0000}or save up for one big move.{0010}Switch between them to suit the{0000}situation, and you'll be{0010}a full-fledged Tojinshi.{0010}

Tojinshi exist to protect this{0000}world from evil, my boy.{0010}With the "Drive," they borrow{0000}the power of wild "shikigami."{0010}First, talk to a shikigami{0000}and make it your ally.{0010}Set ally shikigami and{0000}they can join battles.{0010}Set up to three of them{0000}before a battle.{0010}To set them, open the "Drive menu"{0000}and choose "Swap."{0010}Once a battle starts, only those{0000}three can take part.{0010}Every shikigami has another{0000}shikigami that's its natural enemy.{0010}Learn the battle order and when to{0000}swap by heart, and you'll grow strong.{0010}
